description:
Layman's Flame works to bring all of mankind to the ultimate reality and truth.

The ultimate truth is that Catholicism is the one true faith and church established by Jesus Christ himself almost 2000 years ago. 

How? By equipping lay faithful to spread the flames of faith through beauty and truth in a darkening 21st century context with beautiful and informative evangelization and catechetical posters. These posters are conversation-starters, reminders, and great gifts for family, friends, and communities.

Pope St John Paul II kicked off The New Evangelization in the 80’s and 90’s inspiring generations of Catholics. The struggle to spread the faith continues to this day for lay faithful to do their part in actively bringing the truth of Catholicsim to the world.

Each and every one of us has a role to play in the conversion of the world. These posters are merely a means for the Holy Spirit to open peoples eyes and minds. No different from a beautiful cathedral that is meant to bring people to God.

Take your part and tangibly bring the Catholic faith to your home, classrooms, or communities so as to do your part in this spiritual war.
parish: Our Lady of Mount Carmel - Littleton
